description: Mini Games' policy (its renovate.json at 93ed780): weekly grouped minor/patch, security at once, 3 days stability, pinned versions and action digests; never automerged — every kit change is a reviewed PR.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all non-major updates.
Node stays as the kit states it: engines.node ">=22" and .nvmrc "22" move together, by hand, never by Renovate (DECISIONS K38; #25 once wrote "v26.13.1" into engines).
A peer range is widened, never pinned or replaced: a new major becomes "^19.3.1 || ^20.0.0", so games on the old major keep working (DECISIONS K37).
Peer ranges are what games may bring: no minor, patch or pin bump of a peer; only a major reaches them (DECISIONS K37).

customManagers.description: The scanner images in the workflows' env: (`*_IMAGE: <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>`), which no built-in manager reads (audit 2026-11-22, B6 info; tests/renovate.test.ts).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the weekly schedule and the stability wait.
